about.summary: Hands-on AI engineering experience across Generative AI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, intelligent search, document intelligence, AI chatbots, workflow automation, and backend API development. Experienced with Python, LangChain, FAISS, Hugging Face, FastAPI, NLP pipelines, and modern LLM ecosystems, with additional domain experience in healthcare and biomedical engineering.
about.title: From data to useful systems.
about.signal: Practical AI · Production-minded engineering · Continuous experimentation

details: Developed internal AI-powered workflow automation tools for reporting, task management, attendance tracking, content management, and operational processes using Python and FastAPI.
Built Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based document search and knowledge-assistant solutions using LangChain, Hugging Face embeddings, and FAISS.
Designed AI-assisted content management and reporting workflows to streamline administrative operations and reduce repetitive manual tasks.
Developed backend APIs and automation services for integrating LLM-powered features into internal platforms and business workflows.
Worked on document processing, semantic search, prompt engineering, and LLM-based information retrieval use cases.
Collaborated with product and business teams to rapidly prototype AI solutions, convert requirements into working applications, and iterate based on stakeholder feedback.
Contributed to backend architecture, system integration, and optimization of AI-powered features.
Built a Sentiment Trend Reader dashboard for a private client using Google Trends, sentiment analysis, and related news coverage to analyze sentiment around trending topics.
Developed the solution using Python, LLM-based sentiment analysis, and external data sources, delivering a functional analytics dashboard for the client's use case.
Worked as part of the Biomedical Engineering team at Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals, supporting hospital equipment and operations.
Contributed to the setup and biomedical infrastructure planning for a 50-bed Apollo Women’s Cancer Centre in Defence Colony.
Managed and maintained 250+ critical medical devices including ventilators, multipara monitors, infusion pumps, and diagnostic systems, maintaining 99% equipment uptime.
Performed daily operational rounds and coordinated high-priority breakdown troubleshooting with OEM engineers and clinical teams.
Developed Python-based tools to automate equipment audit checklists and generate preventive-maintenance alerts, improving audit readiness and reducing manual errors.
Managed procurement cycles including vendor negotiation, quotation comparison, technical evaluation, and inventory coordination.
Maintained CM/PM activities, AMC/CMC schedules, and regulatory documentation in alignment with JCI and NABH standards.
Collaborated cross-functionally during installations, retrofitting, and project execution across OR, ICU, NICU, and diagnostic departments.
Applied machine learning and data analysis techniques to solve business-oriented problems using Python and data science libraries.
Worked with Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn to build and evaluate predictive models and analytical solutions.
Performed data collection and web scraping using APIs and BeautifulSoup to support data-driven projects.
Worked with MySQL for data extraction, cleaning, transformation, and analysis.
Developed a Book Recommender System using collaborative and content-based filtering.
Built a Resume Analyzer/Parser using NLP, entity recognition, and skill matching.
Performed Cluster Analysis using K-Means, Hierarchical clustering, and DBSCAN.
Collaborated using GitHub and participated in project-based development workflows.
Provided installation, calibration, and technical support for critical-care and diagnostic equipment including ventilators, anesthesia machines, monitors, ECGs, X-Ray machines, and syringe pumps.
Handled preventive and corrective maintenance across hospitals in Rajasthan and Delhi NCR, maintaining approximately 95% uptime for life-saving devices.
Coordinated with OEM teams and hospital staff to troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues and minimize equipment downtime.
Created Excel- and Python-based tools to log maintenance history, schedule preventive maintenance, and auto-generate service reports.
Trained clinical staff and nurses on equipment usage and conducted on-site demonstrations for new installations.
Managed spare-parts inventory, cost estimations, and vendor negotiations to support service execution.
Maintained compliance with hospital protocols and biomedical safety standards.
